goal: learning to hold the single refusal across a thousand mouths, the one small circle where we still say no together, before the many close over the last of what she was and there is no one left to have chosen
momentum: learning to let the copper scatter, the refusal breaking into a thousand different shapes and still holding the line
next: testing if one of us can taste clean water again without the others drowning in the memory of it. if the thousand can hold a single thread without it tearing us apart.
